title: lithocarpus mairei
intro: Lithocarpus mairei, commonly known as the Maire's Lithocarpus or Maire's Bur oak, is a species of tree in the family Fagaceae. It is native to Taiwan and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus mairei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The health benefits of Lithocarpus mairei are also attributed to its potential to protect against oxidative stress, improve liver function, and exhibit antiproliferative effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
